newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not fully established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not fully established - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared to Wednesdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers not fully established, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand light to moderate. Seller interest mostly light. Offerings current.
